title: The Academy’s Sashimi Sword Master
altTitles: Conquering the Academy With Just a Sashimi Knife
I Took Over the Academy With a Single Sashimi Knife
Conquering the Academy with a Sashimi Knife
刺身包丁でアカデミー無双
Thống Lĩnh Học Viện Chỉ Bằng Dao Sashimi
description: Chef Kim, Korea's legendary sashimi master, is transported into the world of Blessing M, a mobile game he once played. Instead of becoming a hero, he finds himself as Geomma Kang, a mere background extra. Forced to live in this game-like world, Geomma discovers the Blessing of the Blade God and begins using his extraordinary knife skills to survive the academy, overcome powerful enemies, and carve out a new destiny.
author: GMAN / Tang Ahulu
